collection.title: Peugeot 407 Coupe 2004 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Peugeot 407 Coupe 2004 to 2011 model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Side Pin arm attachment.
